command:
cd "/d/Research Paper/paper" && python - <<'EOF'
import re
s=open('main.tex',encoding='utf-8').read()
n1=len(re.findall(r'\$p=(\\[A-Za-z]+)\$',s)); n2=len(re.findall(r'\$p_\\text\{Holm\}=(\\[A-Za-z]+)\$',s))
s=re.sub(r'\$p=(\\[A-Za-z]+)\$',lambda m:'$\\pv{'+m.group(1)+'}$',s)
s=re.sub(r'\$p_\\text\{Holm\}=(\\[A-Za-z]+)\$',lambda m:'$\\pv['+'\\text{Holm}'+']{'+m.group(1)+'}$',s)
pre=("% p-value macros hold either a number or \"<0.001\"; print \"p = x\" or \"p < x\" accordingly\n"
 "\\newcommand{\\pv}[2][]{\\edef\\pvtmp{#2}\\expandafter\\pvaux\\pvtmp\\relax{#1}}\n"
 "\\def\\pvaux#1#2\\relax#3{\\ifx<#1 p_{#3}<#2\\else p_{#3}=#1#2\\fi}\n")
s=s.replace("\\input{method_numbers}\n","\\input{method_numbers}\n"+pre,1)
if "caption" not in s.split("\\begin{document}")[0].split("usepackage{graphicx")[1][:200]:
    s=s.replace("\\usetikzlibrary{positioning,arrows.meta}\n","\\usetikzlibrary{positioning,arrows.meta}\n\\usepackage[skip=4pt]{caption}\n",1)
open('main.tex','w',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n').write(s)
print(n1,n2)
EOF
grep -n 'pv\|caption}' main.tex | head
description: Replace p-value uses with a p-value macro and add caption spacing
